verdict.rationale: Fellow ships a Developer API, webhooks and an MCP server, so a sandbox or test environment is a fair question for this product. Nothing in the pack documents a sandbox, test workspace, test-mode keys or dry-run mode. The nearest items are related but different: per-application API keys, and a find/replace endpoint that returns a 422 and changes nothing on a bad match. Neither isolates tests from production data.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can test against a sandbox environment without touching production data
